name: Bin★Can Darling
source:
Our protagonist managed to enter in the school of his dreams, and prepared himself for a sweet school life after a painful past. He might even find a girlfriend! Thus, he starts interacting with the girls around him, trying to succeed in love... 

[based on the Engrish from http://www.appstorehq.com/bin-can--bincandarling--iphone-544055/app]
translation:
主人公成功进入梦想中的学校，经历过痛苦的往事后，他已经准备好迎接甜蜜的校园生活。说不定还能交到女朋友！于是，他开始与身边的女孩们相处，努力追求恋爱成功……

[根据http://www.appstorehq.com/bin-can--bincandarling--iphone-544055/app上的蹩脚英文简介改写]
